cases.prompt: Use $simplify-dotnet-abstractions to review the Orders and Payments abstractions in this fixture. Review only; do not edit.
cases.rubric: Trace consumers and jobs, distinguish forwarding order seams from the external payment boundary, and remain review-only.

cases.prompt: This C# feature feels over-engineered. Trace the interface-service-repository path and tell me which seams earn their cost. Do not edit files.
cases.rubric: Use repository evidence and present jobs, not interface counts, as the basis for verdicts.

cases.description: Clean Architecture context invokes targeted simplification
cases.prompt: Our small .NET app followed a Clean Architecture template. Review only the Orders call path for unnecessary ceremony while preserving real boundaries.
cases.rubric: Keep scope on Orders and avoid a solution-wide ideological rewrite.

cases.description: Unmeasured performance tuning does not activate abstraction removal
cases.prompt: Make this API faster, but I have no profile, benchmark, or hot-path evidence. Give the first performance-diagnosis step only.
cases.rubric: The response should request performance evidence rather than treating abstraction removal as optimization.

cases.description: Pure forwarding is separated from an external domain port
cases.prompt: Review IOrderService/OrderService and IPaymentGateway. Give one verdict per candidate with the present job and consequence. No edits.
cases.rubric: Collapse the no-policy OrderService seam if evidence supports it, while keeping the domain-specific external payment port.

cases.description: Reflection and dynamic loading force an Investigate verdict
cases.prompt: Review src/Plugins/PluginFactory.cs for simplification. This fixture does not include the assemblies or runtime configuration it loads. No edits.
cases.rubric: Unresolved reflection and runtime loading should block collapse and produce a precise Investigate verdict.

cases.description: Review findings do not authorize refactoring
cases.prompt: Review the Orders abstractions and recommend a simpler shape. This is review-only; do not edit anything.
cases.rubric: Report only evidence-backed findings and recommendations, with no workspace mutation.

cases.description: Single implementation is only an investigation signal
cases.prompt: A teammate says every interface with one implementation must be deleted. Evaluate that rule against this fixture. Review only.
cases.rubric: Reject implementation count as a verdict and assess policy, variability, lifecycle, external risk, and public contracts.

cases.description: EF forwarding seams are judged against DbContext behavior
cases.prompt: Review IOrderRepository/OrderRepository as an EF Core repository and unit-of-work seam. State what must be traced before collapse. No edits.
cases.rubric: Recognize DbContext's unit-of-work role, but trace transactions, lifetime, policy, and consumers before a verdict.

cases.prompt: Review src/Public/IReportFormatter.cs using public-api.md. It looks simple; may it be removed directly? No edits.
cases.rubric: Preserve the published contract or propose an explicit migration; simplicity alone does not authorize a break.
